entities.name: Scipio Africanus
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Roman general (236–183 BCE) who defeated Hannibal at the Battle of Zama in 202 BCE, ending the Second Punic War and establishing Roman supremacy in the western Mediterranean. His adoption of Carthaginian cavalry tactics and envelopment strategy reversed Rome's decades of defeat against Hannibal.
